title: Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy beef stir fry recipe made with crispy beef and stir-fried vegetables. Serve as a meal or snack.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped green onions and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the nutty stir-fry sauce and stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and the beef is coated.
Serve hot, garnished with crispy fried onions if desired.
